title: Playing opposite Bix and sitting in at the Garden of Allah
summary: Willard and Davison pin down the first time he heard Bix at a college gym dance, and the first time he dared to play beside him at an all-night Cincinnati hangout.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: Now, at one of these points, you played opposite-- this is a point that I hope to get straightened out -- in your biography--- you and I have argued about this but this is when you played opposite Bix----- that was actually the first time you played with him in public - right?
Tell about that. My argument is about what -- exactly when it happened-- the one at the Miami School for Girls -- just tell about that date.
Well, we had a band on one side of

the hall and, uh, we were playing all these arrangements and it was - me muted - straight mutes and bucket mutes and all these things-- and I-- we got off the stand-- we were the first ones to play and, of course, it was a hugh--- it was actually a gymnasium-- it was a basketball court actually. And, that band was way at the other end and when I heard that open horn---
Well this was the first time you had heard him---
Yeah, the first time I had heard him---
I just wanted to get this occasion (inaudible).

But, when we used to go in Cincinnati - we used to go to a place - a tremendous hangout for all the musicians working and, believe me, Cincinnati was loaded with musicians at that time. And, plenty had places to play. And, we used to go to a place called - "The Garden of Alla" and it was a place where the booze was cheap, the food was cheap; there was plenty of places to park your car and it was always packed with people at four and five o'clock in the morning. And, that's the first time I really had the courage to play along with Bix and play the second part. Or, play any part I could play. You know, there'd be all kinds of guys sitting in the band; if you felt like sitting in in that place, you just got up and played. So, that's
the first time I had the courage to really play with Bix . you know, and play along side of him.
And, I found I could get along all right. I certainly was far from being the sound of Bix ., of course.
